findings.evidence: Mathlib `Reduced.lean:202` declares `instFlipIsReduced [P.IsReduced] [IsTorsionFree R N] : P.flip.IsReduced`; none of the proofs otherwise mentions the `M` instance.
findings.fix: Remove `[Module.IsTorsionFree R M]` from the section variables, retaining only `[Module.IsTorsionFree R N]`.
findings.issue: `[Module.IsTorsionFree R M]` is unused in all three theorems of `section Dual`; only torsion-freeness of `N`, the root space of `P.flip`, is needed.

findings.evidence: The proof applies the main theorem to target `P₂.flip`; Mathlib `Reduced.lean:202` requires torsion-freeness only of `P₂`'s coroot space `N₂` to construct that target's reducedness.
findings.fix: Drop `[Module.IsTorsionFree R M₂]` and retain `[Module.IsTorsionFree R N₂]`.
findings.issue: `nonempty_equiv_flip_of_hasCartanType_B_C` unnecessarily assumes `[Module.IsTorsionFree R M₂]`; only `N₂` is required for `P₂.flip.IsReduced`.

summary: The duality corollaries impose torsion-freeness on both ambient modules although flipping and target reducedness require only the new root space.
